subject: Milestone alignment: reconcile target delivery windows
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Lopez <alicia.lopez@velahealth.com>, Tom Gill <tgill@velahealth.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Milestone alignment: initial pipeline export and ask

Hi team,

I ran a quick export of our VelaHealth opportunities and flagged items where the Salesforce "Target Delivery" (custom close-equivalent) is >30 days from the last activity or where Stage = "Negotiation" but there's no signed timeline. Export attached (sf_export_velahealth_20270516.csv).

Quick asks: 
- Alicia / Tom: can you confirm which of the items in rows 3, 7, and 12 are still on track for the target month listed? If not, please provide an updated target delivery month or move to "Stalled".
- Lauren / Monica: please confirm whether finance should treat any of these as at-risk for this quarter's commit. If so, mark them with the custom field "Forecast Risk = High" and add a 1-sentence reason in the Opportunity Notes.

Notes: I highlighted two deals (opp #0065g00000XXXX and opp #0065g00000YYYY) with inconsistencies between Close Date and Target Delivery — likely data drift after the technical review. Would like these reconciled by EOD Tuesday so we can run the mid-week forecast scrub.

Attachment: sf_export_velahealth_20270516.csv (CSV, 98 rows)

Thanks,

David
David Kim
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>

Cc: Alicia Lopez <alicia.lopez@velahealth.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 12:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Milestone alignment: initial pipeline export and ask

David — thanks for the export and the flags. Ordered a quick pass below.

Summary actions for internal owners: 
- Monica: please run a stage audit tonight for any Opportunity with Stage in ["Negotiation","Legal Review"] and Last Activity > 21 days. Pull the list and paste it into the Forecast Notes (we need traceability for finance).
- Me: will coordinate with VelaHealth on the three rows you called out.
- David: please add "Forecast Risk" tags for any deal you think should be pulled from commit.

Alicia — quick request for you and Tom: if you can reply with a "green/amber/red" status for each of these opps by EOD Tuesday (17 May), that will let us lock the mid-week forecast. If any are red/amber, a line with the blocker (e.g., legal timeline, procurement, budget) is ideal.

I attached a one-page draft timeline (vela_timeline_draft.pdf) that proposes where we think milestones should land if the current signals are accurate. It's intentionally conservative.

Thanks — short bullets in reply are perfect.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0123
